entity: US primary-care shortage-area (HPSA) designations from 1978-89 still designated today (national measure)
what_we_add: 143 of 999 date from 1978-89; 31 still score 18+; named worst counties (Humphreys, Jefferson, Copiah MS at 22; Jim Hogg TX at 23)
why: GAO (2) states in words that HPSAs which no longer meet criteria keep their designation, and Paragon (3) that many designations sit unreviewed since the 1970s-80s: the same persistence finding, same direction, for the national measure.
